mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_token (user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked) VALUES (#{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.token_hash, t.expires_at, t.revoked, t.created_at, t.last_used_at, u.account, u.display_name, u.role FROM auth_token t JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.token_hash = #{hash} AND t.revoked = 0 AND t.expires_at > #{now} AND u.enabled = 1 LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_token SET revoked = 1 WHERE token_hash = #{hash}
UPDATE auth_token SET last_used_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
